data.title: 神尾观铃 · 海天一色处的张臂飞翔
data.description: 长堤的尽头直插海中央，天地之间只有澄澈的碧蓝。观铃扔下草帽，踩在窄窄的水泥堤顶张开双臂，宛如一只即将振翅飞向长空的白色雏鸟，回眸露出毫无杂质的微笑。
data.location: narrow concrete sea embankment extending into the infinite sapphire ocean horizon
data.action: balancing barefoot on the seawall edge with arms spread wide like wings, yellow sundress billowing in sea winds, turning with a radiant smile
data.lighting: brilliant azure daylight enveloping sea and sky into one seamless expanse of blue
data.mood: transcendent poetic freedom, innocent heart-aching longing, pure celestial grace
data.promptProse: Balancing joyfully along the ocean seawall with arms outstretched, Misuzu turns with a breathtaking smile amidst endless blue sea and sky.
data.animaCaption: Misuzu balancing on the breakwater with arms spread wide in the sea breeze.
